title: Chicken Breed Standard Daily Feed Intake — Day 1 to Day 40

measure.unit: grams per live bird per day
measure.age_basis: Day 1 is the first day after placement; Day 40 is the 40th day of age.
measure.sex_basis: As-hatched / mixed-sex, unless a source states otherwise.
measure.feed_basis: Complete feed intake, not including wastage.

important_use_notes: These are planning targets, not guaranteed outcomes. Actual feed intake changes with sex, dietary energy and nutrient density, pellet/crumb quality, temperature, ventilation, stocking density, health status, lighting, water availability, and feed wastage.
Daily values from published tables may not sum exactly to published cumulative intake because source tables are rounded.
For exact cost and inventory forecasts, use the official profile for the actual hatchery strain and replace any proxy reference in this file with the breeder or hatchery's current guide.
Cobb 500 Days 1–7 are intentionally labeled as estimated because the cited 2022 official source publishes only Day-7 cumulative intake and starts daily intake at Day 8.

ross_308_ap_2022.profile_name: Ross 308 AP / AP95 — As-Hatched Performance Objectives (2022)
ross_308_ap_2022.source_notes: AP95 is commonly used commercially for Ross 308 AP. Daily feed intake is feed consumption per living bird. Days 1–6 are calculated from rounded cumulative-intake values.

cobb_500_2022.source_notes: The source publishes Day-7 cumulative intake (180 g) and daily intake from Day 8 onward. Days 1–7 below are a monotonic allocation totaling 180 g and should be treated as a planning estimate; Days 8–40 are directly from the source.
